jobs.title: Senior Certification Specialist
jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Our Certification team sits within Legal & Compliance and makes sure every game and platform component LeoVegas Group launches is properly certified for each regulated market we operate in. As Senior Certification Specialist, you’ll be the team’s subject-matter expert: leading complex certification and audit projects, owning our day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs and setting how the team certifies across markets, so launches stay on track and the Group’s licences stay protected. You’ll work closely with the Gaming, Casino, Change Management and Technical Compliance teams, as well as external test labs and game suppliers, and report to the Certification Manager. It’s a role with real ownership and variety: you’ll shape procedures, turn regulatory and technical-standard changes into practical requirements, and help build the capability of the wider team by mentoring Certification Specialists and Officers. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Lead end-to-end certification and audit projects for games, platform and critical components across our regulated markets Own day-to-day relationships with accredited test labs, including scoping, quotes, timelines and escalations Act as the senior escalation point for complex certification issues raised by the business and the certification team Monitor regulatory and technical-standard changes and turn them into clear certification requirements Review certificates and test reports for gaps and agree corrective actions with labs and game suppliers Plan certification timelines with stakeholders so certification never blocks a launch Own and improve internal certification procedures, market checklists and post-certification reviews Mentor Certification Specialists and Officers and share jurisdiction knowledge across the team OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS In-depth knowledge of certification requirements for online gambling across multiple regulated markets Extensive experie

jobs.title: Assurance Lead
jobs.description: I quit medicine because I kept watching patients die needlessly, for avoidable reasons. In almost every case, the medical knowledge and clinicians were there. It was the system that failed: the way information moved, decisions got routed, and fragmented teams and data turned solvable problems into tragedy. I started Anima to change that. Our mission is human wellbeing, and we believe personalised medicine will transform it. Our founding insight is that getting there requires a system that learns continuously from care and its outcomes, optimising for human wellbeing. Building that learning engine is the opportunity at the heart of Anima. We're now in 1,000+ clinics across 5 product lines, serving more than 25% of the UK population. We are cash flow positive, growing fast, and have a tight crew of ~45 people who care deeply for each other and the mission. Everyone has real ownership and a voice in decisions. Multiple trillion-dollar companies will be built in healthcare over the next two decades. We intend to be one of them. If you want to work on problems where the stakes are high, you belong at Anima. Your work here will save lives. -- Shun Assurance Lead Healthcare organisations need confidence that the technology they use is clinically safe, protects patient data and can withstand serious scrutiny. At Anima, assurance is not a box-ticking function: it shapes how we build, earn customer trust and bring our technology to more clinicians and patients. We’re looking for an intellectually sharp, pragmatic assurance leader to build and own this function. What you’ll do Shape product decisions. Work closely with Product and Engineering to understand how Anima operates, identify risks early and translate clinical, regulatory and data-protection requirements into practical decisions. Build the assurance function. Own the systems, documentation and processes behind customer and product assurance—including DPIAs, clinical-safety documentation and customer assurance material

jobs.title: Rekrutmen Legal Counsel PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk
jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
